name: Each Academy Card Is As Tall As Its Tallest Tab
greenMarker: every card is as tall as its tallest tab
note: The gate serves the built bundle, so every mutation here rebuilds. These cover how the Academy is laid out since D34 (2026-10-27): the 표준 | 킬러 switch first, the classic stages as tabs under it, killer as one list.

mutations.name: the killer stage goes back into the tab bar
mutations.why: The bug D34 fixed, restored: 「1단계 … 5단계 · 킬러」 in one row, a difficulty and a kind of puzzle side by side, killer reading as a sixth stage after grandmaster (user: "킬러랑 클래식 나열이 바보 같이 되어 있어").
mutations.expectFailure: classic shows its stages as tabs and only those

mutations.name: the Academy forgets the kind Home remembers
mutations.why: A killer player opening the Academy would land on classic stage 1 every time — and a kind picked here would never reach Home, the AI lobby or the daily, which share one remembered choice (KP-11).
mutations.expectFailure: the Academy opens on the remembered kind

mutations.name: a kind picked here is not remembered
mutations.why: Read on opening but never written: the Academy shows killer, the player goes back, and Home still offers classic — two answers to "which kind am I playing", which is what the one setting exists to prevent.
mutations.expectFailure: the kind picked here is the one Home remembers

mutations.name: killer draws a tab bar of one
mutations.why: A single tab that can only ever be selected is a control that does nothing, and it pushes the eight techniques down for no reason.
mutations.expectFailure: killer shows its techniques with no tab bar

mutations.name: switching the kind sends classic back to stage 1
mutations.why: A player on stage 3 who glances at killer and comes back should find stage 3, not have to find their place again.
mutations.expectFailure: the classic stage is kept across a kind switch
